_comment: The JSON body search("q", options) sends. Options are named as on the wire (site, published_after, published_before, acquired_after, acquired_before, snippet_max_length, max_results, query_time, mode); each SDK maps them to its own names. An empty string means the option is unset (Go cannot tell the two apart), and an unset mode is "pro". `sent` is the whole body, compared as JSON. `skip` names an SDK whose released types cannot express the case, with why.

skip.go: SearchOptions.MaxResults is an int whose zero means unset, as released in go/v0.1.1

cases.name: the query is sent as given
